title: Skull Eye Mountain Vision
description: A massive green skull dominates the foreground with one glowing pink concentric eye and an ornate decorative second eye containing a smaller skull inside. Behind it stretches a surreal mountain landscape under a vibrant sunset sky with swirling purple clouds, while glowing yellow human silhouettes stand along the ridges and drip from the skull's jaw.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic landscape featuring a giant green skull in the foreground with one glowing pink spiral eye socket and an ornate decorative eye containing a smaller skull inside its iris. The skull's jaw drips green liquid while glowing yellow human silhouettes stand on its surface and along mountain ridges. Dramatic mountain range in the background with purple and orange peaks under a swirling colorful sunset sky filled with purple vortex clouds, vibrant fantasy colors, detailed digital painting.
